name: rayen-extension
description: Chrome MV3 extension: Rayen/Eloisa atenciones, ficha clínica e interconsultas for Hospital Hanga Roa

scripts.check: npm run lint && npm test && npm run cycles:check && npm run docs:check && npm run release:check
scripts.pack: npm run check && rm -f rayen-extension-$npm_package_version.zip && zip -r -q rayen-extension-$npm_package_version.zip manifest.json app.html app.js popup.html popup-init.js report.html report.js src styles vendor icons README.md ARCHITECTURE.md DOCUMENTATION_MAP.md MAPA_API.html CHANGELOG.md && unzip -l rayen-extension-$npm_package_version.zip | tail -1
